NeTF is a neural modeling framework for Non-Line-of-Sight (NLOS) imaging that recovers the 5D transient function (spatial location and direction) implicitly represented by a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) [S1].

The claim states that NeTF is a neural modeling framework for NLOS imaging that recovers the 5D transient function (spatial location and direction) implicitly represented by an MLP. Source [S1] explicitly confirms this in the Conclusion section: 'We have presented a novel neural modeling framework called the Neural Transient Field (NeTF) for NLOS imaging... NeTF recovers the 5D transient function in both spatial location and direction.' It further states: 'Same as NeRF, the final reconstruction of the hidden scene corresponds to a 3D density volume, implicitly represented by the MLP.' The notes also corroborate these specific facts.
